A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh

git fetch origin 4f318de6644dc35ad759e3af51a0ff961d95ae9f && git checkout 4f318de6644dc35ad759e3af51a0ff961d95ae9f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 900e48935638a328b8aaa32ad5ddc29efa0f8dc3

2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。

```
Serialized Error: { status: 1, signal: null, output: [ null,

This PR's diff is `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/outbox-sweep{,.test}.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection{,.test}.ts`, `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` and a changeset — **nothing under `packages/spec`, and nothing touching a port, a socket, a shell script or the network.**

I have recorded this as #10370's second confirmed occurrence: [#10370 (comment)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/10370#issuecomment-5360568786).

⚠️ The triage bot above reports *"24h 窗口内只有本 PR 撞到过"*. That is a **floor, not a count** — its own caveat says the comment ledger was not read to the end of the window, and #10365's hit fell past its page budget. Do not read it as "first time".
